Three suppliers have an indexed price cap clause in their supplier agreement (Clause 6, "Pricing" — unit prices subject to an indexed price cap, adjusted annually by CPI, capped at 4%):

1. **Acme Components** — supplier-agreement-acme.docx (line 13)
2. **Borealis Metals** — supplier-agreement-borealis.docx (line 13)
3. **Corvid Plastics** — supplier-agreement-corvid.docx (line 13)

Note: Dunmore Industrial's agreement (supplier-agreement-dunmore.docx) explicitly states prices are fixed for the term and **not** indexed, so it is excluded. The numbered supplier-agreement-XXX.docx files (005, 010, 015, etc.) did not contain an indexed price cap clause (they matched the "index/cap" search only incidentally, e.g., via words like "update" or "approval" containing no actual price-cap clause).
